exam: 113年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、113年公務人員特種考試國際經濟商務人員考試、113年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、113年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 國際經濟(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員英文組二

essays.text:
Taiwan is currently seeking to participate in the Comprehensive andProgressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP). The CPTPP isa model of free trade agreement with high quality and high standards. Inaddition to the liberalization in goods trade, the agreement also covers theliberalization in services trade.
① Analyze diagrammatically the welfare impacts of participating in the CPTPPin terms of trade creation effect and trade diversion effect. (15 points)
② Explain the modes of services trade and the types of barriers to servicestrade. (10 points)

We often observe in trade data a phenomenon where a country simultaneouslyexports and imports automobiles. What is this phenomenon called? Pleaseexplain the causes of this phenomenon and analyze diagrammatically theimpact of trade liberalization on the welfare of consumers and producers inthat country. (25 points)
What is the gold standard? In this system, without government intervention,how would adjustments naturally occur in the event of the balance ofpayments (BOP) deficit/surplus? (25 points)

mcq.q: The depreciation of a currency may cause an initial worsening of the balance of payments before itimproves. This is called the _____.
opts: J-curve effect
Marshall Lerner condition
exchange rate overshooting
price-specie flow mechanism

mcq.q: A Japanese bank buys U.S. government bonds, and this purchase _____.
opts: increases U.S. net capital outflow and has no impact on Japanese net capital outflow
increases U.S. net capital outflow and increases Japanese net capital outflow
increases U.S. net capital outflow, but decreases Japanese net capital outflow
decreases U.S. net capital outflow, but increases Japanese net capital outflow

mcq.q: In order to determine how strong or weak a currency is, you should pay more attention to the _____.
opts: real exchange rate
forward exchange rate
bilateral exchange rate
effective exchange rate

mcq.q: If covered interest parity holds, then _____.
opts: firms should be able to identify opportunities for arbitrage in investments
the difference between two countries’ interest rates should roughly equal the forward discount orpremium between their currencies
international interest rates should be equal
forward rates should equal spot rates

mcq.q: If the dollar depreciates relative to the Swiss franc, then _____.
opts: Swiss chocolate will become cheaper in the United States
American computers will become more expensive in Switzerland
Swiss chocolate will become more expensive in the United States
Swiss computers will become cheaper in the United States

mcq.q: The theory of purchasing power parity (PPP) suggests that if the price level of one country rises relativeto that of the other country, its currency should _____.
opts: depreciate in the long run
appreciate in the long run
depreciate in the short run
appreciate in the short run

mcq.q: One of the most important and most visible roles of the IMF is to _____.
opts: investigate countries that are charged with being unfair traders
provide loans to countries that need capital to develop their economies
intercede by invitation when countries cannot pay their international debts
hold regular negotiations over tariff reductions

mcq.q: If a central bank makes a sterilized purchase of foreign assets, then the domestic currency will _____.
opts: appreciate
depreciate
either appreciate, depreciate, or remain constant
not be affected

mcq.q: The WTO permits the creation of a regional trade agreement (RTA) _____.
opts: only if the RTA is a partial trade agreement
when the RTA includes a most-favored nation clause
when the RTA leads to more trade creation than trade diversion
if all members of the RTA are also members of the WTO

mcq.q: The following table shows the production of wheat (bushels per hour) and cloth (yards per hour) forCountry A and Country B.In order for both countries to gain from trade, one bushel of wheat must trade for_____.Country A＿＿＿Country BWheat＿＿＿12＿＿＿6Cloth＿＿＿6＿＿＿18
opts: between 1/2 and 2 yards of cloth
between 6 and 18 yards of cloth
between 1/2 and 3 yards of cloth
between 1/3 and 3 yards of cloth

mcq.q: In the two-country model of international labor mobility, _____.
opts: the long-run equilibrium global real wage is equal to the greater of the pre-migration wages in the two countries
the long-run equilibrium global real wage is equal to the lesser of the pre-migration wages in the two countries
the effect of migration is to cause real wages in the two countries to diverge
the effect of migration is to cause real wages in the two countries to converge

mcq.q: According to the Heckscher-Ohlin model, the source of comparative advantage is a country’s _____.
opts: technology
factor endowments
human capital
trade policy

mcq.q: If a good is imported into a small country like S from a large country like F, then the imposition of a tariffin Country S _____.
opts: lowers the price of the good in S and raises it in F
raises the price of the good in S and lowers it in F
raises the price of the good in both countries
raises the price in Country S and does not affect its price in Country F

mcq.q: In the exporting country, an export subsidy in the short run will _____.
opts: help consumers and raise the overall economic welfare of the exporting country
help consumers but lower economic welfare of the exporting country
hurt consumers and lower the overall economic welfare of the exporting country
hurt consumers but raise the overall economic welfare of the exporting country

mcq.q: The important difference between tariffs and quotas is that tariffs _____.
opts: generate tax revenue for the government
raise the price of the good
help domestic producers
stimulate international trade

mcq.q: The situation when export-biased growth by poor nations would worsen their terms of trade so much thatthey would be worse off than if they had not grown at all is called _____.
opts: distorted growth
immiserizing growth
imbalanced growth
misalignment growth

mcq.q: Which of the following transactions is a debit in a country’s current account?
opts: Export of merchandise.
Gifts to foreigners.
Foreign bond purchases.
Export of services.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a feature of a common market?
opts: Free trade in goods and services between the members.
Common external barriers to trade.
Substantial coordination of macroeconomic policies among the members.
Factor mobility.

mcq.q: Which of the following does NOT appear in the current account part of the balance of payments?
opts: A loan of $1 million from Bank of America to Brazil.
Foreign aid to El Salvador.
An Air France ticket bought by an American.
Income earned by General Motors from its plants abroad.

mcq.q: The Ricardian model of international trade demonstrates that trade can be mutually beneficial. Why dogovernments restrict imports of some goods?
opts: Restrictions on imports can have significant beneficial effects on domestic consumers.
The Ricardian model is often incorrect in its prediction that trade can be mutually beneficial.
Imports are only restricted when foreign-made goods do not meet domestic standards of quality.
Trade can have significant harmful effects on some segments of a country’s economy.
